annotations.title: Turn a site module on or off

description: Turn one of your site's extras on or off: feedback (feature request board), reports (bug report form), beta (beta tester sign-up), promo (promo code page), remote_config (app-config.json for force updates, maintenance and notices), changelog, press (press kit) or status (status page). Their settings are kept.

enabled.description: true to turn it on, false to turn it off.

site.description: Your site: its address ("habitly" for habitly.apppage.net) or id, as list_my_sites returns.

name: set_module
title: Turn a site module on or off
